take.title_zh: AI 工具衝浪期：多模型發布潮與 Figma 代理人進化
take.title_en: Surfing the AI Wave: Multiple Model Launches and Figma Agent Evolution
take.body_zh:
六月底的 AI 市場正在經歷密集發布潮——Gemini 3.5 Pro、Claude Mythos 1、Claude Sonnet 4.8 與 Grok 5 預計在同一個月內陸續登場。對 PM 與設計師而言，每一次大模型發布都代表工具鏈與提示策略需要重新評估，速度壓力前所未有。

與此同時，Figma AI Design Agent 自五月進入 limited beta，標誌著 AI 正式進入設計軟體的「主動執行」層：agent 能讀取設計系統、直接操作圖層。設計師角色正從「執行者」轉向「指揮者」，與 Figma 2026 調查中 85% 設計師認為 AI 是未來關鍵的數據相互呼應。
take.body_en:
Late June 2026 marks a rare convergence: Gemini 3.5 Pro, Claude Mythos 1, Claude Sonnet 4.8, and Grok 5 are all racing to launch within weeks of each other. For product teams, each new flagship model compresses the window to finalize API routing, budget decisions, and prompting strategies.

Meanwhile, Figma's AI Design Agent entered limited beta in May — a qualitative shift from AI as suggestion panel to AI as active executor inside the canvas. Figma's own 2026 survey found 85% of designers now view AI competency as essential to career success, confirming the transition from experiment to standard practice.

articles.title_zh: 六月 AI 發布潮：Builder 的四大模型決策地圖
articles.title_en: June 2026 AI Launch Wave: A Builder's Decision Map
articles.summary_zh: WaveSpeed 整理六月底 AI 發布潮全貌，Gemini 3.5 Pro、Claude Mythos 1、Claude Sonnet 4.8 與 Grok 5 預計在同一時間窗口密集登場。文章以「Builder 的決策地圖」框架分析各模型適用場景、定價預測與切換成本，協助產品與開發團隊提前規劃 API 路由策略。Grok 5 因 Colossus 2 訓練仍在進行，Polymarket 估計六月底前發布機率僅 12–33%，為最大不確定因素。
articles.summary_en: WaveSpeed maps the converging June 2026 AI release wave: Gemini 3.5 Pro, Claude Mythos 1, Claude Sonnet 4.8, and Grok 5 are all targeting the same narrow launch window. The piece frames each model's best-fit use cases, estimated pricing, and switching costs to help product and builder teams pre-plan API routing strategies. Grok 5 remains the wild card — Polymarket puts a June 30 release probability at just 12–33% due to ongoing Colossus 2 training.
articles.take_zh: 四大旗艦模型同月競逐是罕見現象，對 PM 而言意味著 API 預算與架構選型決策必須在數週內定案。這張決策地圖值得在下一次團隊規劃會議前先讀過。
articles.take_en: Four flagship models converging in one month is unusual. For PMs, it compresses the window for API routing and architecture decisions. Map your team's use cases against this framework before your next planning sprint.

articles.title_zh: 2026 年 6 月 AI 重大事件全覽
articles.title_en: AI News — June 2026: Key Events & Releases
articles.summary_zh: dentro.de 整理六月 AI 重大事件，包含 Anthropic Claude Fable 5（6 月 9 日發布，Mythos 級別通用模型，SWE-bench Verified 達 95%，定價 $10/$50 per million tokens）以及各大廠預計發布模型的時程。文章分類整理研究突破、產品發布與政策監管三大面向，適合需要快速掌握月度 AI 格局的 PM 與設計主管閱讀。
articles.summary_en: dentro.de compiles June 2026's major AI milestones, headlined by Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 (released June 9, Mythos-class, 95% SWE-bench Verified, $10/$50 per million tokens). The roundup covers research breakthroughs, product launches, and regulatory developments, organized for quick scanning by PMs and design leads who need to track the month's overall AI trajectory without deep technical dives.
articles.take_zh: Claude Fable 5 的 95% SWE-bench Verified 是工程自動化的重大里程碑。對設計師而言，程式碼生成的可靠性大幅提升，意味著設計到開發的交付流程正在加速重塑。
articles.take_en: Claude Fable 5's 95% SWE-bench score marks a major milestone for engineering automation reliability. For design teams, this signals that code generation is dependable enough to meaningfully reshape handoff workflows — a practical shift, not a distant prospect.

articles.title_zh: Figma 推出 AI 設計代理人，設計師第一線怎麼看？
articles.title_en: Figma Just Launched Its AI Design Agent — Here's What Designers Are Saying
articles.summary_zh: Figma AI Design Agent 自 5 月 20 日起向部分用戶 limited beta，這是真正嵌入 canvas 的代理人——能讀取設計系統、直接操作圖層，而非只是建議面板。文章匯整設計師社群第一手反應：有人視為工作流程革命，有人質疑創意自主性將往哪走。AI agent 正式「動手做設計」，不只是功能升級，而是設計師角色定義的分水嶺事件。
articles.summary_en: Figma's AI Design Agent began limited beta rollout on May 20, 2026 — embedded in the canvas, reading your design system, editing layers directly rather than suggesting from a sidebar. This Medium roundup captures first-wave designer reactions: excitement over workflow speed, tension around creative ownership. The agent marks a shift from AI as advisor to AI as co-executor, fundamentally reframing what a designer's daily role looks like.
articles.take_zh: 當 AI 能直接操作圖層，設計師的核心價值移向「判斷力」與「品味」。這不只是學新工具的問題，而是重新定義自己不可取代性的時刻——越早思考越好。
articles.take_en: When AI edits layers directly, a designer's core value shifts to judgment and taste — not execution speed. This isn't just 'learn a new tool' territory. It's time to redefine where you're irreplaceable. Think about it now.

articles.title_zh: Figma AI 2026 完整評測：能做什麼、還不能做什麼
articles.title_en: Figma AI in 2026: Everything It Can Do — and What It Still Can't
articles.summary_zh: LogRocket 從實戰角度梳理 Figma AI 2026 年的能力邊界：文字生成佈局（First Draft）、智慧元件建議、圖像編輯、程式碼 handoff 自動化與 Figma Sites 全站生成均已可用。但複雜互動邏輯、多品牌設計系統管理與無障礙自動修正仍是明顯盲點。評測依使用場景分類，是評估是否調整設計工作流程最務實的參考指南。
articles.summary_en: LogRocket's practitioner-focused 2026 review maps Figma AI's real capability boundary: text-to-layout (First Draft), smart component suggestions, image editing, code handoff automation, and Figma Sites generation all work well. Persistent gaps include complex interaction logic, multi-brand design system governance, and accessibility auto-correction. Organized by use case, this is the most practical guide for teams deciding how to restructure Figma workflows around AI features.
articles.take_zh: Figma AI 的強項集中在「快速原型」與「單次任務自動化」，但複雜設計系統管理與無障礙合規仍需人工把關。先搞清楚能力邊界，再談工作流程的大幅重設計。
articles.take_en: Figma AI shines at rapid prototyping and single-task automation, but complex design system governance and accessibility compliance still need human judgment. Know the boundary before restructuring your workflow around it.

articles.title_zh: 2026 設計產業關鍵數據：85% 認為 AI 是職涯必備能力
articles.title_en: 79+ Design Statistics: Tools, Collaboration, and AI in 2026
articles.summary_zh: Figma 調查全球 906 位設計師與開發者，發布 2026 設計產業數據報告，涵蓋工具使用率、跨職能協作模式與 AI 採用狀況。核心數據：85% 受訪者認為 AI 技能對未來職涯成功不可或缺。AI 工具採用已從「實驗」進入「標配」階段，報告同時揭示設計師與 PM 在工具選擇上的收斂趨勢，以及跨職能協作效率的整體變化。
articles.summary_en: Figma surveyed 906 designers and developers across North America, APAC, Europe, LATAM, and the Middle East for its 2026 design industry data report. The headline: 85% say AI skills are essential to future career success. AI adoption has shifted from experimental to baseline. The report also surfaces convergence in tool choices between designers and PMs, and tracks evolving patterns in cross-functional collaboration efficiency.
articles.take_zh: 85% 代表 AI 技能已從「加分項」進入設計師的「必備清單」。若你的團隊還在觀望，這份調查清楚表明業界已大幅超前——視窗不是快關閉了，而是幾乎已關閉。
articles.take_en: 85% signals that AI competency has crossed from bonus to baseline. If your team is still on the sidelines, this data shows the industry has moved significantly ahead. The window to catch up isn't closing — it may already be nearly shut.

articles.title_zh: 2026 UX 設計師 AI 工具全覽：Figma 官方整理
articles.title_en: Top AI Tools for UX Designers in 2026
articles.summary_zh: Figma 官方整理 2026 年 UX 設計師最值得關注的 AI 工具，依設計流程階段分類：草圖與原型生成、使用者研究自動化、可用性測試輔助、設計系統管理與 A/B testing 各有推薦工具。清單幫助設計師辨識哪些流程環節最適合導入 AI、哪些仍需深度人工投入，是建立系統性 AI 輔助設計工作流程的起點參考。
articles.summary_en: Figma's official 2026 guide curates the leading AI tools for UX designers by design process phase: wireframing and prototyping, user research automation, usability testing support, design system management, and A/B testing. The phase-based taxonomy helps designers identify where AI adds the most leverage and where deep human involvement remains essential — a practical entry point for building systematic AI-augmented design workflows.
articles.take_zh: 選工具前先問「我在哪個流程環節最需要速度或規模？」這份清單的核心價值在分類邏輯，不在工具數量。AI 工作流程整合應有優先順序，不是一次全面導入。
articles.take_en: Before picking tools, ask: where do I most need speed or scale? The value of this guide is its phase-based taxonomy, not the tool count. AI workflow integration should be prioritized by impact, not deployed all at once.

articles.title_zh: Figma 2026：AI 如何重塑多渠道產品設計？
articles.title_en: Figma in 2026: How Multi-Channel Product Design Will Evolve With AI
articles.summary_zh: 文章探討 AI 如何重塑 Figma 在多渠道設計場景（網頁、行動、穿戴、車載 HMI）的角色。隨著 AI 能自動適配 component 至不同尺寸與平台規範，設計師角色從「手動適配者」轉為「規則制定者」。作者提出，品牌一致性的治理能力將成為設計師新護城河——不是靠手工精細操作，而是靠能定義「AI 不能亂動邊界」的系統思維。
articles.summary_en: This Bootcamp piece examines how AI is reshaping Figma's role across multi-channel product design — web, mobile, wearables, automotive HMI. As AI handles adaptive component resizing and cross-platform spec compliance, designers shift from manual adapters to rule-setters. The author argues that brand consistency governance becomes the new designer moat: not pixel-perfect execution, but the systemic thinking to define what AI must not override.
articles.take_zh: 從「執行」到「規則制定者」的角色轉換，需要設計師對每個決策的「為什麼」有更深理解。AI 讓技法門檻下降，判斷力的門檻反而提高——這是同一件轉型的兩面。
articles.take_en: The shift from executor to rule-setter demands a deeper understanding of the 'why' behind every design decision. AI lowers the execution bar while raising the judgment bar — two sides of the same transformation.
